svg.text: The research run: the plan chosen, and the plan as it was
Only if needed: a split, a hand-over
Framed: a test of the method, apart from the tree
A line joins each one to the one that starts it.
As chosen: a coordinator and one helper for each of seven fields
As planned: the full run, with the pilot inside it
The pilot is one leaf, T, and its test.
